ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(ApprovalStatus__c, "Approved")), NOT(ISNEW()), OR( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Approval Pending", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Approved", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Rejected", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Denied", TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Accepted" ), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(SBQQ__Status__c), OR( AND( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Approved", TEXT(SBQQ__Status__c) = "Presented" ), AND( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Presented", TEXT(SBQQ__Status__c) = "Denied" ), AND( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c)) = "Presented", TEXT(SBQQ__Status__c) = "Accepted" ) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Quote cannot be modified in its current status. Only specific status changes are allowed (Approved→Presented, Presented→Denied, Presented→Accepted).
